projects.title: Data Vandals: open data visualization kiosk at 51st & Lexington
projects.description: BetaNYC's April Public Interest Technologist of the Month installed a live open-data visualization kiosk on the downtown 6 platform at 51st & Lexington. Staffed Fri 4/24 and Sun 4/26, 3-6pm.
projects.why_interesting: Puts NYC Open Data in front of actual straphangers instead of in a browser tab. Rare example of civic data in a public transit space.

projects.title: NYC child care program map (Mamdani administration)
projects.description: New citywide search tool aggregating center-based child care resources — location, cost, and availability — into a single searchable map.
projects.why_interesting: First consolidated public view of a fragmented resource landscape; a clear test of the new administration's data-delivery promises.

projects.title: Philadelphia Kensington Dashboard
projects.description: Launched by Philly Stat 360, the dashboard pulls data from across city departments into a regularly updated public view of services, resources, and progress in the Kensington neighborhood.
projects.why_interesting: Neighborhood-level accountability dashboard tied to a specific crisis geography — a pattern other cities will watch.

projects.title: Ithaca Housing Dashboard
projects.description: Public housing inventory tracker: 14,629 total units, 1,690 designated low/moderate income, plus development pipeline metrics. A plain-English one-stop for local housing data.
projects.why_interesting: Small-city housing dashboards are an underexplored genre — replicable template for mid-size cities.

projects.title: BetaNYC Mapping for Equity
projects.description: New BetaNYC program and training series on mapping NYC's public realm to surface equity gaps in accessible public space.
projects.why_interesting: Frames mapping as an equity intervention, not just visualization. April 21 session kicked off the public curriculum.

projects.title: Washington Post: ChatGPT's hidden bias about your state or city
projects.description: Interactive feature based on 20M+ queries to ChatGPT asking it to rank states, cities, and neighborhoods. For NYC: SoHo and West Village rank highest, Jamaica and Tottenville lowest.
projects.why_interesting: A geography-of-AI-bias piece — reveals how LLMs encode place hierarchies, with a neighborhood drill-down.

projects.title: LA Speed Cameras Map
projects.description: New interactive map from the LA City Controller showing speed camera locations across LA, launched alongside a refreshed FY2025 Unspent Homelessness Funds Dashboard.
projects.why_interesting: A working example of a Controller's office pushing transparency via map + dashboard, not reports.

projects.title: LA Housing Progress Dashboard
projects.description: LA City Planning's refreshed dashboard breaks out housing production by affordability level, geography, and pipeline stage.
projects.why_interesting: Moves housing reporting from annual PDFs to live visual tracking — a direct counter-model to NYC's HPD reporting cadence.

projects.title: Open NY April 2026 quarterly report
projects.description: New York State's Q1 2026 report on dataset additions, updates, and open-data portal activity across state agencies.
projects.why_interesting: The most systematic public accounting of what's actually moving on NY's open data portal — useful baseline for anyone auditing transparency.

projects.title: School-bus on-time performance dashboard (Restler bill)
projects.description: Councilmember Lincoln Restler introduced legislation requiring DOE to publish a public dashboard of school bus on-time performance — data the agency currently keeps internal.
projects.why_interesting: Legislative path to pry open operational data that agencies routinely hide. Worth tracking as a template.

projects.title: Urban Institute Upward Mobility Data Dashboard (April 2026 update)
projects.description: Refreshed April 7 with 24 Mobility Metrics predictors across counties nationwide, covering economic conditions and racial equity gaps tied to upward mobility from poverty.
projects.why_interesting: County-level mobility data is hard to find in one place; the update adds fresh comparisons across US cities.

projects.title: Pittsburgh public-housing data dashboard (forthcoming)
projects.description: Post-Gazette reports a forthcoming public dashboard consolidating Pittsburgh public-housing information, an area where public data has historically been patchy.
projects.why_interesting: Another mid-size city taking the housing dashboard playbook. Watch the launch for what data makes it in and what gets left out.
